```{r}
#merge interactions lists- do not run again unless new lists added. This is ALL the lists for ALL turtles from 24 hr CATS deployments, including those ending in _interaction and those without an interaction. 

library(dplyr)  
library(stringr)

input_directory <- "/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/All Annotations for Interactions Turtles"
output_file <- "merged_interactions_annotations.csv"

annotation_files <- list.files(path = input_directory, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

merged_interactions_annotations <- bind_rows(
  lapply(annotation_files, function(file) {
    df <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df[] <- lapply(df, as.character)
    return(df)})) 

merged_interactions_annotations <- merged_interactions_annotations %>%
  mutate(Observation.id = str_replace(Observation.id, "_interaction$", "")) 

output_directory <- "/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)"

write.csv(merged_interactions_annotations, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
interactions.data <- read.csv("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/merged_interactions_annotations.csv") 

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)

interactions.data <- interactions.data %>%
  rename(ObservID = "Observation.id", BehavCat = "Behavioral.category") %>%
  group_by(ObservID) %>%
  mutate(ObservID = str_replace(ObservID, "_interaction$", "")) %>% 
  mutate(VidNum = row_number()) %>%
  rename(TimeStamp = Time) %>%   #rename column Time to TimeStamp
  
#create DeployID column using Observation.id info minus the numbers at the end specifying which video for a deployment
  mutate(DeployID = str_extract(ObservID, "^[^_]*_[^_]*")) %>%

#Adding in a column for video dates, extracting date from video file name
 mutate(date_data = str_extract(Source, "\\d{8}")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(date_data, format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  select(-date_data) %>%
    
#move DeployID column to be first column
  select(DeployID, everything()) %>% 

#Make sure Time is always first behavior to avoid issues with alphabetical reordering  
  group_by(ObservID) %>%
  arrange(Behavior != "Time", .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
#Create new column Time to add time stamps formatted as actual time of day, hh:mm:ss.sss
  mutate(Time = if_else( 
    Behavior == "Time" & BehavCat == "Record Keeping",
    str_replace_all(str_pad(as.character(Modifier..1), 9, pad = "0"), 
    "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{3})", "\\1:\\2:\\3"), NA_character_)) %>%

#Create a start time column  
  mutate(StartTime_raw = if_else(
    Behavior == "Time",
    str_pad(as.character(Modifier..1), 9, pad = "0"), NA_character_)) %>%
  mutate(StartTime_formatted = if_else(
    !is.na(StartTime_raw),
    str_replace(StartTime_raw, "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{3})", "\\1:\\2:\\3"),NA_character_)) %>%
  group_by(ObservID) %>%
  mutate(ObservStartTime = dplyr::first(na.omit(StartTime_formatted))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-StartTime_raw, -StartTime_formatted) %>%
  
#Create an end time column
  mutate(Behavior = if_else(Behavior == "End time", "End Time", Behavior)) %>%
  mutate(ObservEndTime_temp = if_else(
    Behavior == "End Time" & BehavCat == "Record Keeping" & !is.na(Modifier..1),
    str_replace_all(str_pad(as.character(Modifier..1), 9, pad = "0"),
      "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{3})", "\\1:\\2:\\3"),NA_character_)) %>%
  group_by(ObservID) %>%
  mutate(ObservEndTime = dplyr::first(na.omit(ObservEndTime_temp))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(ObservEndTime = if_else(is.na(ObservEndTime), "", ObservEndTime)) %>%
  select(-ObservEndTime_temp)
  
#Create a release time column; use later to remove first 3 hours of data for *capture and handling* purposes
library(readr)
fallback_data <- read_csv("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/MissingReleaseTimes.csv", 
                          col_types = cols(DeployID = col_character(), ReleaseTime = col_character(), ReleaseDate = col_character())) %>%
  mutate(ReleaseTime_fallback = format(parse_time(ReleaseTime, locale = locale(tz = "UTC")), "%H:%M:%S"),
         ReleaseDate_fallback = as.Date(ReleaseDate, format = "%Y%m%d"),DeployID = trimws(as.character(DeployID))) %>%
  select(DeployID, ReleaseTime_fallback, ReleaseDate_fallback)

release_dates <- interactions.data %>%
  mutate(DeployID = trimws(as.character(DeployID))) %>%
  mutate(VideoNum = as.integer(str_extract(ObservID, "(?<=_)(\\d+)$"))) %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Release Time" & BehavCat == "Record Keeping") %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = VideoNum, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(trimws(Source)),
    Date_str = map_chr(str_extract_all(Source, "20\\d{6}"), ~ tail(.x, 1)),
    Date_formatted = as.Date(Date_str, format = "%Y%m%d")) %>%
  select(DeployID, Release_Date = Date_formatted)

interactions.data2 <- interactions.data %>%
  mutate(
    ReleaseTime_raw = if_else(
      Behavior == "Release Time" & BehavCat == "Record Keeping",
      str_extract(as.character(Modifier..1), "^\\d{9}"), NA_character_),
    ReleaseTime_str = if_else(
      !is.na(ReleaseTime_raw),
      str_replace(
        substr(ReleaseTime_raw, 1, 6), # HHMMSS
        "(\\d{2})(\\d{2})(\\d{2})", 
        "\\1:\\2:\\3"), NA_character_)) %>%
  left_join(release_dates, by = "DeployID") %>%
  group_by(DeployID) %>%
  mutate(
    ReleaseTime_str = dplyr::first(na.omit(ReleaseTime_str)),
    Release_Date = dplyr::first(na.omit(Release_Date))) %>%
  ungroup()

interactions.data2 <- interactions.data2 %>%
  left_join(fallback_data, by = "DeployID") %>%
  mutate(
    FinalDate = coalesce(Release_Date, ReleaseDate_fallback),
    FinalTime_str = coalesce(ReleaseTime_str, ReleaseTime_fallback),
    ReleaseTime = as.POSIXct(
      paste(FinalDate, FinalTime_str),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  select(-ReleaseTime_raw, -ReleaseTime_str, -ReleaseTime_fallback, -Release_Date, -ReleaseDate_fallback, -FinalTime_str, -FinalDate)

#Below: remove unnecessary columns
interactions.data3 <- interactions.data2 %>%
  select(-"Description", -"Observation.type", -"Media.file.name", -"Image.file.path", -"Comment", 
         -"Observation.date", -"Image.index") %>%

# Using the time stamps noted in the record keeping rows, and adding seconds from TimeStamp, 
  mutate(
    reference_time = case_when(Behavior == "Time" ~ as.numeric(hms::as_hms(Time)), TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    reference_time = zoo::na.locf(reference_time, na.rm = FALSE), 
    reference_time = zoo::na.locf(reference_time, na.rm = FALSE, fromLast = TRUE), 
    Time = case_when(TimeStamp == 0 & is.na(Time) ~ as.character(as_hms(reference_time)), TRUE ~ Time),
    Time = case_when(!is.na(TimeStamp) & is.na(Time) ~ as.character(as_hms(reference_time + TimeStamp)), TRUE ~ Time)) %>%
  
  select(-reference_time) %>% #remove reference time column (was only created for addition purposes)
  mutate(Modifier..1 = if_else(BehavCat == "Record Keeping", "", Modifier..1)) %>%
  
#Create DT column
  mutate(Time = str_pad(Time, width = 8, side = "left", pad = "0")) %>%  
  mutate(Date = format(Date, "%m/%d/%Y")) %>%
  mutate(DT = paste(Date, Time)) %>%
  mutate(DT = mdy_hms(DT)) %>%
  select(-Date, -Time, -TimeStamp) %>%
  relocate(DT, .after = 2) %>%

#Format End Time column
  mutate(DateOnly = as.Date(DT),
    ObsEndTime = as.POSIXct(paste(DateOnly, ObservEndTime), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  select(-DateOnly) %>%

#Format Start Time column
  mutate(DateOnly = as.Date(DT),
    ObsStartTime = as.POSIXct(paste(DateOnly, ObservStartTime), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  select(-DateOnly) %>%
  
#Adjust times for 2 feb deployments that were not adjusted for the time change before deploying
  mutate(DT = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR12"), DT - hours(1), DT)) %>%
  mutate(ReleaseTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR12"), ReleaseTime - hours(1), ReleaseTime)) %>%
  mutate(ObsStartTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR12"), ObsStartTime - hours(1), ObsStartTime)) %>%
  mutate(ObsEndTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-11_CR12", "CC-11-12_CR12"), ObsEndTime - hours(1), ObsEndTime)) %>%
#Adjust times for CC-11-145_CR1 deployment that was mistakenly in UTC +5 instead of UTC -4
  mutate(DT = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-145_CR1"), DT - hours(9), DT)) %>%
  mutate(ReleaseTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-145_CR1"), ReleaseTime - hours(9), ReleaseTime)) %>%
  mutate(ObsStartTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-145_CR1"), ObsStartTime - hours(9), ObsStartTime)) %>%
  mutate(ObsEndTime = if_else(DeployID %in% c("CC-11-145_CR1"), ObsEndTime - hours(9), ObsEndTime)) 
  
interactions.data4 <- interactions.data3 %>%      
#Changing column names of modifiers to make sense and label what they actually are and separating modifiers by categories
  rename(LifeStageSubject = Modifier..6, SexSubject = Modifier..7, BodyConditionSubject = Modifier..8, 
         SignsDiseaseInjurySubject = Modifier..9, AggressionInitiator = Modifier..10) %>%
  mutate(LifeStageSubject = ifelse(is.na(LifeStageSubject), "", LifeStageSubject)) %>%
  mutate(SexSubject = ifelse(is.na(SexSubject), "", SexSubject)) %>%
  mutate(BodyConditionSubject = ifelse(is.na(BodyConditionSubject), "", BodyConditionSubject)) %>%
  mutate(SignsDiseaseInjurySubject = ifelse(is.na(SignsDiseaseInjurySubject), "", SignsDiseaseInjurySubject)) %>%
  mutate(AggressionInitiator = ifelse(is.na(AggressionInitiator), "", AggressionInitiator)) %>%  
  
  mutate(SpeciesSubject = if_else(Modifier..5 %in% c("Cc", "Cm", "Lk"), Modifier..5, ""), 
         Modifier..5 = if_else(Modifier..5 %in% c("Cc", "Cm", "Lk"), "", Modifier..5), 
         SpeciesSubject = ifelse(is.na(SpeciesSubject), "", SpeciesSubject)) %>%
  
  rename(InteractionTimeStamps = Modifier..5) %>%
  mutate(InteractionTimeStamps = ifelse(is.na(InteractionTimeStamps), "", InteractionTimeStamps)) %>%

#modifiers for interaction bottom type at start vs end  
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(., "Hard bottom", "Hard Bottom"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(., "Sandy bottom", "Sandy Bottom"))) %>%
  mutate(InteractionBottomTypeStart = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..1 %in% 
                                                c("Hard Bottom", "Seagrass", "Sandy Bottom", "Mixed", "Unclear"), Modifier..1, ""), 
         Modifier..1 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..1 %in% c("Hard Bottom", "Seagrass", "Sandy Bottom", "Mixed", "Unclear"), "",
                               Modifier..1)) %>%
  mutate(InteractionBottomTypeEnd = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..1 %in% 
                                              c("Hard Bottom", "Seagrass", "Sandy Bottom", "Mixed", "Unclear"), Modifier..1, ""), 
         Modifier..1 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..1 %in% c("Hard Bottom", "Seagrass", "Sandy Bottom", "Mixed", "Unclear"), "",
                               Modifier..1)) %>%

  mutate(ForagingLocation = if_else(Modifier..1 %in% c("Benthic", "Surface", "Pelagic"), Modifier..1, ""), 
         Modifier..1 = if_else(Modifier..1 %in% c("Benthic", "Surface", "Pelagic"), "", Modifier..1)) %>%
  mutate(VigilanceAbort = if_else(Modifier..1 %in% c("Yes", "No"), Modifier..1, ""), 
         Modifier..1 = if_else(Modifier..1 %in% c("Yes", "No"), "", Modifier..1)) %>%
  rename(InteractionTaxa = Modifier..1) %>%
  
  mutate(SpeciesInteractingWith = if_else(Modifier..2 %in% c("Cc", "Cm", "Lk", "Unknown"), Modifier..2, ""), 
         Modifier..2 = if_else(Modifier..2 %in% c("Cc", "Cm", "Lk", "Unknown"), "", Modifier..2)) %>%

#Modifiers for interaction habitat type at start vs end
  mutate(InteractionHabitatStart = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..2 %in% c("Structured", "Unstructured"), Modifier..2, ""), 
         Modifier..2 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..2 %in% c("Structured", "Unstructured"), "", Modifier..2)) %>%
  mutate(InteractionHabitatEnd = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..2 %in% c("Structured", "Unstructured"), Modifier..2, ""), 
         Modifier..2 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..2 %in% c("Structured", "Unstructured"), "", Modifier..2)) %>%

#modifiers for interaction depth at start vs end  
  mutate(InteractionDepthStart = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..3 %in% c("Bottom", "Midwater", "Surface"), Modifier..3, ""), 
         Modifier..3 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction Start" & Modifier..3 %in% c("Bottom", "Midwater", "Surface"), "", Modifier..3)) %>%
  mutate(InteractionDepthEnd = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..3 %in% c("Bottom", "Midwater", "Surface"), Modifier..3, ""), 
         Modifier..3 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..3 %in% c("Bottom", "Midwater", "Surface"), "", Modifier..3)) %>%
  
  rename(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject = Modifier..3) %>%
  mutate(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject = ifelse(is.na(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject), "", InteractiveBehaviorsSubject)) %>%
  
  mutate(InteractionWinner = if_else(Modifier..4 %in% c("CATS turtle", "None", "Observed turtle 1", "Observed turtle 2", "Observed turtle 3", 
                                                  "Observed turtle 4", "Observed turtle 5"), Modifier..4, ""), 
         Modifier..4 = if_else(Modifier..4 %in% c("CATS turtle", "None", "Observed turtle 1", "Observed turtle 2", "Observed turtle 3", 
                                                  "Observed turtle 4", "Observed turtle 5"), "", Modifier..4)) %>%
  mutate(NextBehavior = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..4 %in% c("Active swim", "Passive swim", "Rest", "Breathing", 
                                                                                   "Vigilance", "Forage", "Other", "Searching"), Modifier..4, ""), 
         Modifier..4 = if_else(Behavior == "Interaction End" & Modifier..4 %in% c("Active swim", "Passive swim", "Rest", "Breathing", 
                                                                                   "Vigilance", "Forage", "Other", "Searching"), "", Modifier..4)) %>% 

  rename(PreviousBehavior = Modifier..4) %>%
  mutate(PreviousBehavior = ifelse(is.na(PreviousBehavior), "", PreviousBehavior)) %>%
  
  mutate(Subject = ifelse(is.na(Subject), "", Subject)) %>%  #Changing any NA subject to just be blank for consistency
  
#Remove columns I don't need for interactions stuff
  select(-"VigilanceAbort", -"ForagingLocation", -"InteractionTaxa") %>%
    
#Reorganizing columns
  select(DeployID, ObservID, DT, ObsStartTime, ObsEndTime, Subject, ReleaseTime, FPS, Behavior, BehavCat, InteractiveBehaviorsSubject, PreviousBehavior, 
         NextBehavior, LifeStageSubject, SexSubject, BodyConditionSubject, SignsDiseaseInjurySubject, SpeciesSubject, SpeciesInteractingWith,
         InteractionWinner, AggressionInitiator, InteractionBottomTypeStart, InteractionBottomTypeEnd, InteractionHabitatStart, InteractionHabitatEnd,
         InteractionDepthStart, InteractionDepthEnd, InteractionTimeStamps, Behavior.type, Source, Observation.duration, Media.duration..s.) %>%
  
  ungroup() %>%

#Clear out any non-turtle interactions  
  filter(!(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & (is.na(SpeciesSubject) | SpeciesSubject == "")))

interactions.data4
```

```{r}
#Pasting interaction start and end info into matching rows for the same interaction 
interaction.info <- interactions.data4 %>%
  filter(Behavior %in% c("Interaction Start", "Interaction End"), Subject == "") %>%
  select(
    ObservID, DT, Behavior,
    PreviousBehavior, NextBehavior,
    InteractionHabitatStart, InteractionHabitatEnd,
    InteractionBottomTypeStart, InteractionBottomTypeEnd,
    InteractionDepthStart, InteractionDepthEnd)

interactions.data5 <- interactions.data4 %>%
  left_join(interaction.info, by = c("ObservID", "DT"), suffix = c("", ".copy")) %>%
  mutate(
    PreviousBehavior = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & PreviousBehavior == "", PreviousBehavior.copy, PreviousBehavior),
    NextBehavior = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & NextBehavior == "", NextBehavior.copy, NextBehavior),
    InteractionHabitatStart = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionHabitatStart == "", InteractionHabitatStart.copy,
                                     InteractionHabitatStart),
    InteractionHabitatEnd = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionHabitatEnd == "", InteractionHabitatEnd.copy,
                                   InteractionHabitatEnd),
    InteractionBottomTypeStart = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionBottomTypeStart == "",
                                        InteractionBottomTypeStart.copy, InteractionBottomTypeStart),
    InteractionBottomTypeEnd = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionBottomTypeEnd == "", InteractionBottomTypeEnd.copy,
                                      InteractionBottomTypeEnd),
    InteractionDepthStart = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionDepthStart == "", InteractionDepthStart.copy,
                                   InteractionDepthStart),
    InteractionDepthEnd = ifelse(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & InteractionDepthEnd == "", InteractionDepthEnd.copy,
                                 InteractionDepthEnd)) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".copy")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))
```

```{r}
#Copy info from start to stop interaction rows so it will show up when data is transformed from long to wide format
interaction_rows <- interactions.data5 %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Species Interaction", Subject == "") %>%
  arrange(ObservID, DT)

interaction_rows <- interaction_rows %>%
  mutate(InteractionGroupID = cumsum(Behavior.type == "START"))

starts <- interaction_rows %>%
  filter(Behavior.type == "START") %>%
  select(
    ObservID, InteractionGroupID,
    PreviousBehavior, InteractionBottomTypeStart,
    InteractionHabitatStart, InteractionDepthStart)

stops <- interaction_rows %>%
  filter(Behavior.type == "STOP")

stops_filled <- stops %>%
  left_join(starts, by = c("ObservID", "InteractionGroupID"), suffix = c("", ".start")) %>%
  mutate(
    PreviousBehavior = ifelse(PreviousBehavior == "", PreviousBehavior.start, PreviousBehavior),
    InteractionBottomTypeStart = ifelse(InteractionBottomTypeStart == "", InteractionBottomTypeStart.start, InteractionBottomTypeStart),
    InteractionHabitatStart = ifelse(InteractionHabitatStart == "", InteractionHabitatStart.start, InteractionHabitatStart),
    InteractionDepthStart = ifelse(InteractionDepthStart == "", InteractionDepthStart.start, InteractionDepthStart)) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".start"))

interaction_rows_updated <- bind_rows(
  interaction_rows %>% filter(Behavior.type != "STOP"),
  stops_filled) %>%
  arrange(ObservID, DT)

interactions.data6 <- interactions.data5 %>%
  filter(!(Behavior == "Species Interaction" & Subject == "")) %>%
  bind_rows(interaction_rows_updated) %>%
  arrange(DeployID, DT) %>%
  select(-InteractionTimeStamps, -InteractionGroupID)

interactions.data6
```

```{r}
#Creating a column for interaction type
interaction.type <- interactions.data7 %>%
  mutate(InteractionType = case_when(
    #Type 3: Aggressive interaction. Any aggressive behavior is present
    str_detect(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject, "Biting|Chasing|Aggressive physical contact|Flee") ~ "Aggressive",
    
    #Type 2: Active interaction. Must include at least one of the type 2 behaviors AND only allowed type 1 + 2 behaviors
    str_detect(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject, "Group resting or cleaning|Follow|Non aggressive physical contact|Displacement|Blocking") &
      !str_detect(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject, "Biting|Chasing|Aggressive physical contact|Flee") ~ "Active",
    
    #Type 1: Passive interaction. Only type 1 behaviors and none of the rest
    str_detect(InteractiveBehaviorsSubject, "^(Approach|Inspect|None)(,\\s*(Approach|Inspect|None))*$") ~ "Passive", TRUE ~ ""))

interaction.type
```

```{r}
#Correcting for frame rate 
library(dplyr)

corrected.data <- interaction.type %>%
  group_by(ObservID) %>%
  # Ensure DT and start/end times are POSIXct
  mutate(
    DT = as.POSIXct(DT),
    ObsStartTime = min(ObsStartTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    ObsEndTime = max(ObsEndTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_duration = as.numeric(ObsEndTime - ObsStartTime, units = "secs"),
    video_duration = as.numeric(max(DT, na.rm = TRUE) - min(DT, na.rm = TRUE), units = "secs"),
    correction = actual_duration / video_duration,
    DT_offset = as.numeric(DT - min(DT, na.rm = TRUE), units = "secs"),
    CorrectedTime = ObsStartTime + (DT_offset * correction)) %>%
  relocate(CorrectedTime, .after = DT) %>%
  ungroup() 

corrected.data
```

```{r}
data.ids <- corrected.data %>%
  mutate(DeployID_num = as.numeric(str_extract(DeployID, "(?<=_)\\d+$"))) %>%
  arrange(DeployID_num, CorrectedTime, Subject) %>%
  mutate(
    DeployNum = dense_rank(DeployID),
    BehavID = as.integer(factor(Behavior)),
    Segment = NA_integer_) %>%
  select(-DeployID_num) %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Subject) %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = if_else(
      Behavior.type %in% c("START", "STOP"),
      cumsum(Behavior.type == "START"),
      Segment)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Subject) %>%
  mutate(
    Segment = if_else(
      Behavior.type == "POINT",
      dense_rank(CorrectedTime),
      Segment)) %>%
  ungroup()

data.ids
```

```{r}
data.ids1 <- data.ids1 %>% #copying species and life stage of CATS turtle into all rows
  left_join(speciessubject, by = "ObservID", suffix = c("", ".filled")) %>%

                                      SpeciesSubject.filled, TRUE ~ SpeciesSubject)) %>%

  left_join(sexsubject, by = "ObservID", suffix = c("", ".filled")) %>%
  mutate(SexSubject = case_when(Subject == "CATS Turtle" & (is.na(SexSubject) | SexSubject == "") ~ 
                                      SexSubject.filled, TRUE ~ SexSubject)) %>%
  left_join(bodysubject, by = "ObservID", suffix = c("", ".filled")) %>%
  mutate(BodyConditionSubject = case_when(Subject == "CATS Turtle" & (is.na(BodyConditionSubject) | BodyConditionSubject == "") ~ 
                                      BodyConditionSubject.filled, TRUE ~ BodyConditionSubject)) %>%
  left_join(diseaseinjury, by = "ObservID", suffix = c("", ".filled")) %>%  
  mutate(SignsDiseaseInjurySubject = case_when(Subject == "CATS Turtle" & (is.na(SignsDiseaseInjurySubject) | SignsDiseaseInjurySubject == "") ~ 
                                      SignsDiseaseInjurySubject.filled, TRUE ~ SignsDiseaseInjurySubject)) %>%
  select(-SpeciesSubject.filled, -LifeStageSubject.filled, -SexSubject.filled, -BodyConditionSubject.filled, -SignsDiseaseInjurySubject.filled) %>%
  relocate(SpeciesSubject, LifeStageSubject, SexSubject, BodyConditionSubject, SignsDiseaseInjurySubject, .after = Subject)
```

```{r}
# change from long to wide format
starts <- data.ids1 %>%
  filter(Behavior.type == "START") %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Segment, Subject, CorrectedTime) %>%
  mutate(pair_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(BehStartTime = CorrectedTime)

stops <- data.ids1 %>%
  filter(Behavior.type == "STOP") %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Segment, Subject, CorrectedTime) %>%
  mutate(pair_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(BehStopTime = CorrectedTime)

interactions.wide <- left_join(
  starts, stops, by = c("DeployNum", "BehavID", "Segment", "Subject", "pair_id"), suffix = c(".start", ".stop")) %>%
  mutate(
    BehDuration = as.numeric(BehStopTime - BehStartTime, units = "secs")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".stop")) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\.start$", "", .), ends_with(".start")) %>%
  relocate(BehStartTime, .after = 2) %>%
  relocate(BehStopTime, BehDuration, .after = "BehStartTime") %>%
  select(-DT, -Observation.duration, -Media.duration..s., -actual_duration, -video_duration, -correction, -DT_offset, -FPS) %>%
  mutate(DeployID_num = as.numeric(str_extract(DeployID, "(?<=_)\\d+$"))) %>%
  arrange(DeployID_num, BehStartTime) %>%
  select(-DeployID_num) %>%
  mutate( #rounding to nearest second, not millisecond
    BehStartTime = lubridate::floor_date(BehStartTime, unit = "1 sec"),
    BehStopTime = lubridate::ceiling_date(BehStopTime, unit = "1 sec"))

interactions.wide
```

Combining behavior and movement data

```{r}
clean.behavior.data <- read.csv("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/clean.behavior.data.2023.to.2026.csv")

final.movement.data <- read.csv("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/final.movement.data.csv")
```


```{r}
library(data.table)  
# merging dfs 
movement <- copy(as.data.table(final.movement.data))
behavior <- copy(as.data.table(clean.behavior.data))

#Fixing messed up date for CC-11-11_CR19
movement[DeployID == "CC-11-11_CR19" & DeployDate == as.IDate("2025-11-04"), 
         DeployDate := as.IDate("2025-04-11")]

# Create interval columns: DT is a point, so treat it as a 0-width interval
movement[, `:=`(start = DT, end = DT)]

#convert start and end to numeric (will be read in from csv as character columns)
movement[, `:=`(
  start = as.numeric(as.POSIXct(start, tz = "UTC")),
  end = as.numeric(as.POSIXct(end, tz = "UTC")))]

# Make sure behavior intervals are named consistently
setnames(behavior, c("BehStartTime", "BehStopTime"), c("start", "end"))

behavior[, `:=`(
  start = as.numeric(as.POSIXct(start, tz = "UTC")),
  end = as.numeric(as.POSIXct(end, tz = "UTC")))]

# Set keys for foverlaps
setkey(behavior, DeployID, start, end)

# Run the overlap join
all.data <- foverlaps(movement, behavior,
  by.x = c("DeployID", "start", "end"),
  by.y = c("DeployID", "start", "end"),
  type = "within",
  nomatch = 0)

#all.data[, c("start", "end") := NULL] #removing strat/end columns
setnames(all.data, c("start", "end"), c("BehStartTime", "BehStopTime")) #bringing back start/end columns

# Rename DT to Time
setnames(all.data, "DT", "Time")

#converting all timestamp columns back to POSIXct
all.data[, `:=`(
  BehStartTime = as.POSIXct(BehStartTime, tz = "UTC"),
  BehStopTime = as.POSIXct(BehStopTime, tz = "UTC"),
  Time = as.POSIXct(Time, tz = "UTC"),
  ObsStartTime = as.POSIXct(ObsStartTime, tz = "UTC"),
  ObsEndTime = as.POSIXct(ObsEndTime, tz = "UTC"))]

#separating df into cats and observed turtles so that OTs aren't erased when i do the below duplucate/overlap cleanup
cats <- all.data[Subject == "CATS Turtle"]
others <- all.data[Subject != "CATS Turtle"]

#setting rules to eliminate overlap + duplication error due to rounding behavior data to match sensor data
cats <- cats[BehStartTime <= Time & Time < BehStopTime]
setorder(cats, DeployID, Time, -BehStartTime)
cats <- cats[, .SD[1], by = .(DeployID, Time)]
all.data <- rbindlist(list(cats, others), use.names = TRUE) #recombine data

combined.data <- all.data %>%
  relocate(DeployNum, DeployDate, ReleaseTime, .after = DeployID) %>%
  relocate(Time, .after = ObsEndTime) %>%
  relocate(BehavID, Segment, BehavCat, BehDuration, .after = Behavior) %>%
  relocate(BehDuration, .after = BehavCat) %>%
  relocate(33:57, .after = BehDuration) %>%
  relocate(Source, .after = last_col()) %>%
  select(-i.start, -i.end)

combined.data
```

```{r}
#FOR FILTERED AND TRIMMED DATA:
#Assign numbers to DeployID, create numbers for Behavior IDs, numbers for each segment of each behavior (then can calculate mean DBA for each segment, for ex)
#data.trimmed <- read.csv("/Users/sophierosengarten/Documents/Master's/Interactions Project/DATA (copies)/data.trimmed.csv")

#Add mean DBA as a column; this is the mean DBA for that behavior event (e.g., that instance of breathing or that interaction)
data.ids.DBA <- data.nostress %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Segment) %>%
  mutate(MeanDBA = mean(DBA, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

#Add avg DBA column; this is DBA as a function of time for that behavior event (e.g., all DBA measurements for a breathing event added up and divided by total time of that breathing event)
data.ids.meanDBA <- data.ids.DBA %>%
  filter(Subject == "CATS Turtle") %>%
  group_by(DeployNum, BehavID, Segment) %>%
  mutate(SumDBA = sum(DBA, na.rm = TRUE), BehDuration = dplyr::first(BehDuration), AvgDBA = SumDBA / BehDuration) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(DeployID != "CC-11-145_CR1") #cut out the aug 2025 kemps
```
